nodes.label: Spec/plan workflow (seven phases)
nodes.rationale: The M0 per-task prompts gave no canonical artifact between idea and code: no spec layer for tickets, no stable PR path, process invisible in the repo (weak portfolio evidence). Seven phases decide, spec, tickets, plan, execute, PR, merge; phases 1-3 user-run, 4-6 agent-run, merge by user; docs/task-template.md and docs/tasks/ prompts removed (user call, 2026-11-23); specs and plans committed and never deleted.

nodes.label: Canonical spec file (specs/NNN-slug.md)
nodes.rationale: Lands on main through a small docs PR before tickets are cut so tickets link a stable path; the GitHub parent issue links to it and does not duplicate it; skill-default tracker publication rejected because it hides specs from tooling that searches repo-root specs/.

nodes.label: Implementation plan file (plans/<issue#>-slug.md)
nodes.rationale: Agent-written per ticket via superpowers:writing-plans template; committed as the first commit of the ticket's PR so the PR reads spec, plan, code; skill-default location docs/superpowers/plans/ overridden by user preference.

nodes.label: Git worktrees disabled (work in place)
nodes.rationale: The dev stack bind-mounts exactly this path (ADR-0004), so a worktree in another directory is not seen by the containers and PHPUnit/Behat would run against the wrong tree; a docker override mounting each worktree was rejected (per-branch local.yml edits in the pinned clone, stacking state on the shadow-volume trick); superpowers:using-git-worktrees Step 0 honors the declared preference; subagent implementers run strictly sequentially in the one tree.
